features.description: Claude Code launches again on macOS 12 (Monterey); the regression came in with 2.1.255, a build that never got a CHANGELOG entry.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Claude Code failing to launch on macOS 12 (Monterey), a regression introduced in 2.1.255
features.ork_disposition_note: ork declares no macOS version floor and no hook branches on the OS release: grep -rniE "monterey|macos 12|darwin 21" over src shared tests scripts manifests CLAUDE.md = 0 hits; the five process.platform checks in src/hooks/src (notification/desktop.ts, notification/sound.ts, permission-denied/denial-notification.ts, setup/*.ts) pick a notifier by platform, not by version. Nothing to change; users on Monterey regain a binary that starts.

features.description: Remote and scheduled sessions no longer fail with "user messages must have non-empty content" after a re-sent permission approval could not be applied.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed remote and scheduled sessions failing with "user messages must have non-empty content" after a re-sent permission approval could not be applied
features.ork_disposition_note: Free. ork drives no remote (claude.ai Remote Control) or scheduled (cloud routine) sessions: every headless caller in ork is a local `claude -p` (ci-sentinel, claude-triage, claude-health, claude-release-watch, labs-version-watch, skill-eval, plugin-validation workflows; tests/evals/scripts/lib/eval-common.sh), which is a different session type. grep for the error text in src, shared/rules, tests, scripts = 0 relevant hits (three unrelated "non-empty content" strings in analytics docs and a script-structure test).

features.description: Four fixes: macOS 'task output swap refused' Bash failures, always-allow not saving in a project with no settings.local.json yet, Remote Control stalls on degraded connections, oversized background-task failure notifications exceeding the API size limit.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed "always allow" not saving in a project that has no .claude/settings.local.json yet
features.ork_disposition_note: Already recorded as featureless in cc-support.json (2026-09-01 note). No settings keys, hook events, tools or permission surfaces changed.

features.description: claude-fable-5-1 is the default Fable model: 1M context, $10/$50 per MTok, cache reads $0.25/MTok.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added Claude Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $10/$50 per Mtok with $0.25/Mtok cache reads
features.ork_disposition_note: Added to src/hooks/src/lib/models.vocab.json (fullIds + pricing, `fable` alias now resolves to 5.1 like CC does) and tests/ci/claude-model-ids.txt. cost-estimator picks the $0.25 cache-read rate up via the vocab import.

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE applies CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL (or the main model) to every subagent, ignoring per-spawn and agent-definition model overrides.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE` to apply `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` (or the main model) to every subagent, ignoring per-spawn and agent-definition model overrides
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/cc-version-settings.md. DEFERRED (S): fable-spend-consent still prompts on an explicit fable pin that CC will ignore when FORCE is set; add an env short-circuit. The 23 explicit `model:` pins (7 haiku, 10 sonnet, 6 opus) and test-agent-model-tool-correlation.sh stay correct as authoring policy but are inert under FORCE; note that in agent-authoring.md.

features.description: `/effort s` sets effort for the current session only; `--effort` now lifts a new model's default-effort hold per session instead of permanently.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `s` in `/effort` to change effort for the current session only, matching `/model`
features.ork_disposition_note: Doc note only. Skill-level `effort:` frontmatter is a different mechanism and is untouched.

features.description: Auto mode prompts once before the first file read outside the working directories; permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories blocks such reads.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a one-time prompt in auto mode before the first file read outside the working directories, with the option to block such reads (`permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories`)
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/cc-version-settings.md. DEFERRED (S): ork skills read ~/.claude (analytics, dream, memory) and cross-repo paths; doctor should warn when the key is true and additionalDirectories does not cover those paths.

features.description: timeFormat and timeZone settings control the turn-end clock and transcript timestamps (12h, 24h, 24h UTC, or strftime).
features.reference_changelog_line: Added "Time format" (`timeFormat`) and `timeZone` settings: 12-hour, 24-hour, 24-hour UTC, or a strftime pattern for the turn-end clock and transcript-view timestamps
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/cc-version-settings.md. Operator proposal: timeFormat 24h.

features.description: Auto mode no longer auto-approves cloud metadata-credential fetches, egress evasion, or cross-tenant reach unless the environment marks them expected.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a Containment Escape rule to auto mode so cloud metadata-credential fetches, egress evasion, and cross-tenant reach are no longer auto-approved unless your environment marks them expected
features.ork_disposition_note: network-egress-guard.ts has no metadata-endpoint coverage (grep 169.254 in src/hooks/src: 0 hits). CC now covers it natively in auto mode; per shared/rules/cc-native-first.md do not add a regex twin.

features.description: defaultMode: bypassPermissions in .claude/settings.json or settings.local.json is now ignored (like auto); set it in user or managed settings or pass --permission-mode.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `defaultMode: "bypassPermissions"` in `.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json` to be ignored, like `"auto"`; set it in user or managed settings, or pass `--permission-mode`
features.ork_disposition_note: Documented in configure/cc-version-settings.md. ork's tracked settings set no defaultMode (grep: 0). Users who fled to bypass mode via project settings (08-31 feedback) lose it silently; the doc says where it must live now.

features.description: Worktree-isolated sessions no longer refuse Bash loops, $VAR reads, "$(...)" and heredocs that never touch git as too complex to verify.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions refusing Bash loops, `$VAR` reads, `"$(…)"` and heredocs that never touch git as "too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree"
features.ork_disposition_note: 25 agents declare `isolation: worktree` (grep src/agents). Free. The cross-repo `git -C` refusal (hq-ext #795) is a different check and is NOT lifted by this bullet.

features.description: Sandboxed git in a linked worktree keeps write access to the common .git directory after cd into a subdirectory.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed sandboxed git commands in a linked worktree losing write access to the repository's common `.git` directory after `cd` into a subdirectory
features.ork_disposition_note: Free. A plausible contributor to the 'worktree operations exit 0 but do nothing' reports in memory; not re-measured here.

features.description: claude -p no longer exits ~5s after its final result while a Monitor the model armed is still running; it waits for the watch to fire or time out.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `claude -p` exiting about 5 seconds after its final result while a Monitor the model armed was still running; it now waits for the watch to fire or time out
features.ork_disposition_note: Headless callers with an outer timeout (tests/evals/scripts/lib/eval-common.sh run_with_timeout 30; ci-sentinel ORK_SENTINEL_PER_PR_TIMEOUT_S 300) will now hit that timeout if the model arms a Monitor. Watch on the next eval run; no code change yet.

features.description: --disallowedTools and session deny rules survive the first settings reload under allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `--disallowedTools` and session deny rules being dropped after the first settings reload when `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` is enabled
features.ork_disposition_note: No ork guard depends on the CLI flag; agent frontmatter disallowedTools is a different mechanism. Free.

features.description: Bash Read()/Edit() deny rules now apply to < file redirects and reader commands like tac and egrep.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Bash `Read()`/`Edit()` deny rules not applying to `< file` redirects and reader commands like `tac` and `egrep`; a deny rule on any argument or redirect target now refuses the command
features.ork_disposition_note: Strengthens the CC-native Read() deny rules that replaced credential-read-guard in purge wave 3 (#3840). Free.

features.description: A permissions.ask rule is no longer skipped in auto mode when the matching command runs inside a compound command or subshell.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a `permissions.ask` rule being skipped in auto mode when the matching command ran inside a compound command or subshell, letting it run without the confirmation prompt
features.ork_disposition_note: Free; ork ships no permissions.ask rules of its own.

features.description: Bash permission checks no longer auto-approve [[ ]] conditionals that zsh parses differently from bash.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Bash permission checks auto-approving certain `[[ ]]` conditionals that zsh parses differently from bash; these commands now prompt for approval
features.ork_disposition_note: Free.

features.description: Plugin component paths (command, agent, skill, hooks) that are symlinks are refused, closing reads outside the plugin directory.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed plugins being able to read files outside their own directory through a declared command, agent, skill, hooks or other component path that is a symlink; such paths are now refused with an error
features.ork_disposition_note: plugins/ork contains 0 symlinks (find -type l, VERIFIED). No-op.

features.description: /add-dir accepts a directory inside the cwd and loads its skills, commands and agents like --add-dir does at startup.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `/add-dir` rejecting a directory inside the current working directory; it now loads that directory's skills, commands, and agents like `--add-dir` does at startup
features.ork_disposition_note: No ork surface depends on it.

features.description: /fork keeps the original conversation's prompt cache in the new background session; the worktree briefing arrives as a message, not a system-prompt change.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved `/fork` to keep the original conversation's prompt cache in the new background session: its worktree briefing now arrives as a message instead of a system-prompt change
features.ork_disposition_note: Free for the 80 `context: fork` skills.

features.description: Subagents cut off mid-stream (sleep, dropped connection, server error) now continue automatically instead of ending with an incomplete response.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed subagents stopping when a response was cut off mid-stream by a computer sleep, dropped connection, or server error; they now automatically continue instead of ending with an incomplete response
features.ork_disposition_note: subagent-stop/retry-handler.ts is orchestration-level (failed agent, suggest alternative), not a mid-stream retry, so nothing to subtract. Free.

features.description: Background sessions: start during macOS npm self-update, state.json detail, Completed ordering, --bg from a deleted dir, --resume double listing, --continue opens finished sessions, old-binary retirement, agents --json raw-mode fix, stashed prompt kept.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `claude agents --json` briefly switching the terminal to raw mode and undoing another program's terminal settings on exit
features.ork_disposition_note: Free. ork drives no `claude --bg`; herdr is a separate multiplexer and unaffected.

features.description: Non-JSONL data piped into claude -p --input-format stream-json fails fast instead of growing memory unbounded.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed unbounded memory growth when non-JSONL data is piped into `claude -p --input-format stream-json`; it now fails fast with a clear error
features.ork_disposition_note: eval-common.sh:258 pipes probe input into --input-format stream-json; a malformed probe now errors instead of hanging. Free.

features.description: Gateway-discovered /model entries may carry a description; discovery runs even under CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC; `fable`/`best` keep resolving to Fable 5 on gateways until 5.1 is configured there.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added support for a gateway-supplied `description` on discovered `/model` picker entries (`CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY`); entries without one still read "From gateway"
features.ork_disposition_note: llm-integration/model-selection.md already documents the discovery env. Note only.

features.description: sandbox.network.deniedDomains entries now block a host written with a trailing dot inside the sandbox.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed sandbox network hosts written with a trailing dot (`example.com.`): a `deniedDomains` entry didn't block the host inside the sandbox, and "don't ask again" for such a host kept prompting
features.ork_disposition_note: Closes a bypass in the deniedDomains rollout (#3322/#3424) that network-egress-guard's retirement is gated on. Free.

features.description: /doctor warns about stale sandbox mask files left by a killed session.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a `/doctor` warning for stale sandbox mask files left by a killed session
features.ork_disposition_note: CC's /doctor now owns this; ork's sandbox-posture lib does not duplicate it (cc-native-first).

features.description: /code-review --comment posts findings on GitLab merge requests via glab mr note.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved `/code-review --comment` to post findings on GitLab merge requests via `glab mr note` instead of reporting the target as unsupported
features.ork_disposition_note: One-line note added to review-pr/SKILL.md next to the existing --comment sentence.

features.description: Settings in a .claude/ folder created after startup are picked up without a restart.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed settings in a `.claude/` folder created after startup not being picked up until restart
features.ork_disposition_note: The ConfigChange settings-reload hook now also sees a late-created project settings file. Free.

features.description: Detached background commands (timeout, setsid) no longer survive a task stop or exit; stopping a background subagent stops its monitors; Claude is told when you stop a background command.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed background commands that detach from their shell (for example under `timeout` or `setsid`) surviving a task stop or Claude Code exit
features.ork_disposition_note: Free.

features.description: --add-dir, /add-dir and additionalDirectories refuse UNC shares and /net automounts.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `--add-dir`, `/add-dir`, and `additionalDirectories` to refuse network paths (UNC shares, `/net/<host>` automounts) with a message before touching them; on Windows use a mapped drive letter
features.ork_disposition_note: No network paths in any ork settings profile.

features.description: Proactive output style sessions idle instead of busy-looping while a background command or Monitor they started is running.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Proactive output style sessions busy-looping with filler messages and repeated log reads instead of idling while a background command or Monitor they started is still running
features.ork_disposition_note: ork ships no Proactive style.

features.description: /btw history browsing moved from left/right arrows to Shift+arrows or [ ]; Ctrl+E command explanation removed from Bash permission prompts.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `/btw` history browsing from `←`/`→` to `Shift+←`/`Shift+→` (or `[`/`]`), stepping through your recent side questions and back to the live answer
features.ork_disposition_note: No ork doc cites the old keys (grep /btw and Ctrl+E: 0 in src).

features.description: managedSourcesBehavior merge takes sandbox.credentials.awsPairs and sandbox.ripgrep whole from the highest source; policyHelper timeouts clamped; shadowed policyHelper runs when the fetch reports removal.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `managedSourcesBehavior: "merge"` to take `sandbox.credentials.awsPairs` and `sandbox.ripgrep` whole from the highest managed source that sets them instead of combining the sources' values
features.ork_disposition_note: No managed settings in the estate.

features.description: Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry header and profile fixes, Remote Control consent and model fixes, gateway TLS pinning, Cowork artifact asks.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed dismissing the Remote Control consent prompt (Esc, or `n` at `claude remote-control`) counting as consent, so the next request connected without asking
features.ork_disposition_note: Not a plugin surface.

features.description: VS Code: account/usage headers, model pill with effort row, output style picker, archive sessions, provider-feature gating.
features.reference_changelog_line: [VSCode] Added output style selection to the command menu, including custom styles
features.ork_disposition_note: Not a plugin surface.
